claims: High Point is a city located in the Piedmont Triad region of central North Carolina.
High Point is primarily in Guilford County.
High Point has parts in Davidson County.
High Point has parts in Forsyth County.
High Point has parts in Randolph County.
High Point is situated between Greensboro and Winston-Salem.
High Point is known as the "Home Furnishings Capital of the World."
High Point is known for the High Point Market.
High Point Market is the world's largest furniture trade show.
High Point University is located in High Point.
High Point's nickname is North Carolina's International City™.
High Point's nickname is Home Furnishings Capital of the World™.
High Point was the highest point on the North Carolina Railroad between Goldsboro and Charlotte.
